article.title: Breakthrough in Open Silicon: University Lab Fabricates 2nm Academic Core
article.deck: In a decisive victory for academic computing autonomy, the university's Advanced Microelectronics Initiative successfully powered on a fully open-source silicon microarchitecture this morning.
paragraphs: The project, code-named Veritas-Core, bypasses proprietary ISA licenses and commercial fabrication paywalls.
Dr. Mateo Chen said the team proved academic clusters can synthesize, route, and physically package industrial-spec microchips independently.
The revision incorporates verified post-launch benchmark figures, including a 31% reduction in thermal dissipation.
